answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so influence persists only when an identity sustains honest, useful service over time. In the EigenTrust-style matrix, a new Sybil has no credible incoming endorsements and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot manufacture trust within its own cluster, leaving it below consensus thresholds. Signed cipher receipts, whether used in timber or ferrous supply chains, still require independent validation.
